Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. Happy to confirm our options so you can pick the flow that fits FinCo. High level:

- Portal e-invoice (XML) — YES. We can emit structured invoices (XML) into our billing portal or push to partner gateways (PEPPOL where applicable).
- Email copy — YES. We can send a PDF copy to a designated AP mailbox in addition to portal delivery.
- VAT fields — YES. Our invoice template supports VAT ID, tax-rate per line item, and a tax-total section. We can include VAT breakdowns for EU invoices.
- SFTP fallback — YES, we support SFTP drops as a fallback (secure key exchange required), and we can also provide an S3 presigned URL delivery if that's easier.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm target channel: PORTAL + EMAIL COPIES (recommended) OR EMAIL ONLY OR SFTP FALLBACK.
2) Provide FinCo billing contact name/email and VAT ID (we only need this once).
3) If you choose portal, we'll send a mapping spec and a test XML (attached: portal-invoice-mapping-spec.xml).

I'm attaching a sample Redwood invoice PDF so your AP team can validate fields. Once you confirm channel and provide the Billing Contact + VAT ID, we'll provision the test feed and run one trial invoice.

Partial answers inline to your AP form attached. Looping in Marissa (Finance) to agree on PO mapping and Vivek (Sales Ops) to approve routing and any contractual visibility we need to record.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
